title: 3_3_The_Dance_Dilemma_Part_2

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
How far in advance would you ask a date to the dance?
Have you ever been on a basketball team?

nodes.text: Owen and $ZOE dash through the halls together, avoiding puddles, water balloons, and other students!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just up ahead!
Owen and $ZOE sprint a few more yards...
Owen darts to the right, opening a service door leading out of the school hallway...
And out into the school parking lot!
The door closes. In the ensuing quiet, they lean against the wall and catch their breath.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Thank goodness we made it out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But it's not her last dance, and as much as I don't like it, she can just go with her friend, what's-her-face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. That one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, before I make the announcement, can I just talk to her? She'll be pretty devastated.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Go talk to Emily. Console her, tell her whatever you want. And then you're going to tell the whole school the dance is on that day `before` lunch ends!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Go talk to Emily. Console her, tell her whatever you want. And then you're going to tell the whole school the dance is on that day [color=#3b78e2][i]before[/i][/color] lunch ends!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why do I care about what Ben Kale wants?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because he has a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you said only 'five guys would be missing the dance', but that's not true. Those five guys `and` their girlfriends would be missing it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you said only 'five guys would be missing the dance', but that's not true. Those five guys [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] their girlfriends would be missing it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, you're kind of right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you see why I can't schedule it on that day?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I see what you're getting at. You don't want to make more people miserable, especially your friend Emily Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why do I care about what Owen Harris wants?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because, uh, he'll be... He'll be sad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Boo hoo... Poor Owen...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! The dates work, $ZOE, and I'm not going to argue with you about it. Just do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, if you can't do it for Owen, at least listen for Emily!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What does Emily have to do with all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily and Ben want to go together. But if Ben's going to be gone, they can't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That sucks for Emily...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But you're tramping on my civil liberties!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if we have the liberty to get into a fight...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sure we do! And I want to exercise that right!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stand down, `Andronicus`, or I'll tell everyone in fourth period that the girl you have a crush on is named--
nodes.text_bbcode: Stand down, [color=#3b78e2][i]Andronicus[/i][/color], or I'll tell everyone in fourth period that the girl you have a crush on is named--

nodes.text: Andrew cuts her off.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Let's not get hasty! Civil liberties aside... I think we can reason this out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! No more fighting! Nerds, you're shaking out each and every one of those costumes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Theater club, stop bullying them. If anyone starts any more fights, I'm revealing all your secrets at a school assembly!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like you have anything on me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I saw you in the computer lab with--

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Never mind! I got it, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Ha ha, suckers!
Taylor turns to Jenna.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't think you're getting off so easily! The theater club still hasn't paid the administration its dues for the semester...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why don't you `figure out` where they are?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]figure out[/i][/color] where they are?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And $ZOE! I need you to make a decision now, or else I'm going to make one `for` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And $ZOE! I need you to make a decision now, or else I'm going to make one [color=#3b78e2][i]for[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got it, Taylor. I know the exact date I want to pick.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good! When is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The second Saturday in December.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? I'm proud of you. When you said all that stuff about pleasing everyone, I was worried you wouldn't have it in you to plan over another group.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What group am I planning over?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, you didn't know? The basketball game is that Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I take my compliment back. You made a mistake. Likely, you thought you were actually going to `make everyone happy...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I take my compliment back. You made a mistake. Likely, you thought you were actually going to [color=#3b78e2][i]make everyone happy...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the office just got field trip permission slips for the basketball team last period stating that they're going to be going away that weekend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does Owen know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. He's the one that turned the slips in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, I have to change the dance date... I can't put it on the day of the basketball game!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's the best day, $ZOE. It's the day I would have chosen if I was in your place.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Only, like, five guys would be missing the dance, and everyone else is happy! That date is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you're going to make an announcement to that effect right now before I have to deal with anymore fights like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, I can't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about...
$ZOE goes to help Dex! Slowly and carefully, she extricates him from the thick fabric. Dex escapes!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Air, sweet air! I can breathe!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you could breathe under there.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I was trying not to move, so that I wouldn't loosen the itching powder too much.
He absently scratches at his arm.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, some still got on me... At least it didn't get into my lungs, so thanks for that.
$ZOE stands up. Meanwhile, Taylor has shoved Jenna and Andrew away from each other.
When Jenna runs for Andrew again, Taylor neatly shoulder chucks her back.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad I went to help Dex... I don't want to be in the middle of that...
Taylor takes Andrew's collar and shoves him to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cool off!
$ZOE tries to help Taylor separate Andrew and Jenna.
She runs over, just as Taylor takes Andrew's collar pushing Jenna back straight into $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Whoa!
Jenna and $ZOE collide, and Jenna's elbow connects with $ZOE's nose!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Tears spring into $ZOE's eyes as her nose aches... They separate while $ZOE rubs her nose.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! When I said 'help', I didn't mean 'act as Jenna's landing mat!` I meant, 'go help Dex'!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly, he's like a stupid cat.
$ZOE turns to Dex, but he's wriggled his way out from under the dress. He sits there, coughing and scratching his back and arms furiously.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cough. Cough. `Cough.` Great! Now `I'm` itching!
nodes.text_bbcode: Cough. Cough. [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough.[/i][/color] Great! Now [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] itching!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ow, Taylor, what'd you pull me off for?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I seriously have to explain why getting into a shoving match with a girl is a bad thing?
$ZOE stands, dumbstruck as Taylor deftly pulls Andrew's collar to tug him out of the shoving match.
She's so rooted to the spot that she doesn't even react when Taylor shoves Jenna into her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I want to fix that starting now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What would someone who's your good friend do for you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, you want to catch my next basketball game? We have an important one coming up soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! That'd be perfect! I'd love to go!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should probably warn you that it's an `away` game, so it's a couple hours away...
nodes.text_bbcode: I should probably warn you that it's an [color=#e23b3b][i]away[/i][/color] game, so it's a couple hours away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. I've taken a road trip with you before. It'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Count me in. Get me a ticket!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! I can't believe I haven't been to one already. I'm such a terrible friend!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I have a feeling I'd do a lot better if you were watching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, then I'd have somebody important to impress.
$ZOE blushes. She meets his eyes for a second, and she smiles at him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, I...
At that moment, the warning bell for classes rings!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We'd better head back inside. The halls are probably safe now that the teachers are walking to their classrooms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure? It seems like the school is ready to tear itself to pieces.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You worry too much. It'll be okay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen. Good bye!
They part ways, and $ZOE heads towards her class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh shoot! I didn't get the chance to talk to Taylor... I guess I'll have to do it at lunch...
A few hours later...
It's lunchtime!
$ZOE enters the hallway cautiously, wary for any signs of slushies or water balloons...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It `seems` safe enough...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]seems[/i][/color] safe enough...

nodes.text: And that's when she sees the nerds and the theater group converging like two hurricanes colliding!
Dex, Taylor, Ashley, and Andrew stop as Jenna and Hannah get in their faces.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Nerds! You've gone way too far!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jenna, what are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: During our dress rehearsal, we found `this` inside our dressing rooms!
nodes.text_bbcode: During our dress rehearsal, we found [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] inside our dressing rooms!

nodes.text: Jenna produces a bottle marked 'itching powder.'

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And then we found the powder over all the costumes!
Hannah angrily lifts one of the theater department's old-fashioned gowns. White itching powder falls to the ground.
Taylor looks from the dress to Dex and Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Please tell me you jokers had nothing to do with this.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Nope! I've never seen a bottle that size, shape, or color before in my life!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah right! This has 'Nerd Central' written all over it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Who` is responsible for pranking the theater group's `costume closet?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Who[/i][/color] is responsible for pranking the theater group's [color=#3b78e2][i]costume closet?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Why do you automatically think it's us?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Because I `also` found this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] found this!

nodes.text: Jenna pulls out a 20-sided die from her pocket and throws it at Dex. It ricochets off his glasses and plinks to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ah! Reflexes! Poor!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Whose` idea was this?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Whose[/i][/color] idea was this?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not ours!
Jenna steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: You're lying. Leave the acting to the actors!
Jenna pushes Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, wait!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You can't push us around!
Hannah throws the dress on Dex, and he falls backwards, tangling himself in the fabric!
Taylor looks around as if searching for an answer. She spots $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is your mess! Help me stop this!
$ZOE rushes over, assessing the situation...
She looks from Dex who appears to be trapped in the voluminous costume skirt and at Jenna and Andrew in a shoving match.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I've been so sad lately...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes it's hard to stop thinking about him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just gets in the way of me being able to just be 'me' around people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you get what that's like?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not really... I've... I've never really been in a bad breakup.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't be. It sounds... `Horrendous.` I don't think I'd want to be there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't be. It sounds... [color=#e23b3b][i]Horrendous.[/i][/color] I don't think I'd want to be there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And I'm sorry you had to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So that's what's been holding me back from being there for Sam to being there for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this Social Chair stuff is hard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've practically blown up the school, and all I did was try to plan a dance!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's hard taking on a new job. You don't have to tell me that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I used to work in the summer for an ice cream stand. One summer, I got promoted from Ice Cream Scooper to Waffle Cone Waffler...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Were those seriously the titles you had?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll have you know that there was a lot of competition to be Waffle Cone Waffler... But the point is, I had no idea how to make waffle cones...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My first day, I couldn't make the cones right... There was a giant hole in the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All the customers who ordered one had ice cream dripping straight onto their shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We gave out so many free ice cream scoops because of the complaints... But eventually, I got the hang of making cones. You will too.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen! That does make me feel better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's still a pretty bad excuse. I haven't been around for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, it's been...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's been pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only 'pretty good'? I thought you were Owen Harris, sports champion of the world.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha! I wish!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not very good. Basketball doesn't come as naturally to me as football. I'm still learning.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm definitely not the MVP of the team. That would go to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben? But he's... He's...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not really the athletic type?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's weird, but he is good. He's always passing the ball to the right person at the right time, and he makes the most ridiculous shots.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, I guess everyone has their surprises.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have any surprise talents? Secret ones I should know about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not unless you count my `sick rap rhymes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not unless you count my [color=#3b78e2][i]sick rap rhymes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { When you're waiting around for your morning ride... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Sometimes you find yourself with the urge to jive... {
$ZOE waves her hands around in a bizarre motion as if keeping in time to some unheard beat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { But it's not cool to keep the dance alive... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Keep it inside, keep it inside... {
Owen claps.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow, that was awful!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did one of those words... `Actually` rhyme?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did one of those words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Actually[/i][/color] rhyme?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha! At least two!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about you? Any secret talents you've got up your sleeve?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can blow bubbles with my spit... Want a demonstration?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha, ew! No, that's all right... Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's only a hit with the right crowd. Mainly middle school boys and my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... No, it isn't...
$ZOE and Owen laugh together for a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, Owen... I'm sorry we haven't been talking lately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've just been so...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's right!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! I know I saw those posters for tryouts around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's basketball going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You really have been out of the loop, haven't you? I actually joined the 'basketball team'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right... I always confuse those 'B' sports!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's basketball going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Basketweaving?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They have that here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, maybe?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I would have been a goner if it wasn't for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad we made it too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for saving me...
Owen drags $ZOE through the hallways, but her shoe slides on a puddle in the hall!
Her hands slips away from Owen's, and she topples backwards to the ground.
$ZOE quickly scrambles to her feet and looks around for Owen, but realizes she and Owen have been separated in the busy crowd!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen? Owen?!
Maria rushes by...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing? Run!
She passes $ZOE. $ZOE tries to follow her, but the other cheerleaders run by, clipping her on the shoulder and spinning her around!
$ZOE gets her bearings just in time to see two water balloons headed right for her face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhhh!
$ZOE shuts her eyes and brings her hands up as water closes around her...
$ZOE has been soaked.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unless you want to be looking over your shoulder for flying slushies all the time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's not exactly happy with me at the moment... Because of the entire Snow Ball date disaster, I probably shouldn't talk to her until I know what day the dance is on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you know now, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of. I don't want to make the announcement until I talk to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should stop by her office before class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like the right plan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you nuts? And get everyone into trouble?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They practically are, Sam. All a teacher has to do is stick his head outside the door, and everyone's going to be in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, but... `You` don't want to be the one who gets blamed for ratting everyone else!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, but... [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] don't want to be the one who gets blamed for ratting everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: These people are crazy! Do you remember that food fight?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe having so many aggressive personalities mad at me isn't such a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should probably go to Taylor before going to the principal...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor's the head of the school. People have to listen to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It can't hurt. Taylor's never been one to stand dissension in her ranks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And she's pretty good at putting people in their place. Back when I was a cheerleader, she told me once that if I fell one more time, she'd gnaw my legs off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She has to know what to do!
Sam pulls $ZOE further down the hall, and they round the corner. To their relief, no one is right next to their lockers.
Sam opens her locker and starts putting her books inside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was totally out of hand! What is wrong with everyone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was totally out of hand! What is wrong with everyone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to do something about this and fast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I can talk to...
$ZOE freezes, her feet rooted to the spot!
The slushie hits her legs, splashing red liquid all over her shoes and socks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek! That's so cold!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And my shoes! They're ruined!
$ZOE angrily looks up, wondering if there'll be more. But Jenna's run off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Slushie... It's going to get worse if we stay here...
Sam throws herself to the side while $ZOE dodges, narrowly avoiding getting her shoes stained by the drink!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes!
$ZOE steadies herself, wondering if there'll be more. But Jenna's run off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was close! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What happened afterwards?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had to wait until everyone used up all the food and left. And then I helped the janitors clean everything up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, it was awful... I didn't know people would `riot` over me not figuring out the right date for the Snow Ball.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, it was awful... I didn't know people would [color=#3b78e2][i]riot[/i][/color] over me not figuring out the right date for the Snow Ball.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Did you pick out the date?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. Every clique has some event on all the Fridays and Saturdays in December that I'd hold the dance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The cheerleaders and the theater club are busy on the first Friday, and the nerds have a convention on the first Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The journalism club and the guys in Auto Shop are busy on the second Friday, and then your swim meet's on the second Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey wait! I can help you with that... We just found out this morning that our match for Saturday was changed to the week before, so we `are` free that day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey wait! I can help you with that... We just found out this morning that our match for Saturday was changed to the week before, so we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] free that day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's amazing! I mean, I should check in with Taylor one last time to make sure... But if nothing else conflicts, that would be the day that works for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, I approve if it falls on a day I can go. Kimi's been talking my ear off about going to this dance all semester, and Ben and I really need a good date night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's perfect. I could make an announcement about it and everything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... If you can calm everyone down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Yeah, you said you and Ben were going to go to some fancy romantic place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Though I can't take you to the `Oceanside Obelisk`, at least I can definitely treat you to somewhere fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Though I can't take you to the [color=#3b78e2][i]Oceanside Obelisk[/i][/color], at least I can definitely treat you to somewhere fun!

nodes.text: Hey, is there a restaurant Ben never wants to go to?

nodes.text: Then you do that! It's on me.

nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.text: Does that sound better?

nodes.text: It sounds great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... It's really not a big deal...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? That's what you're going to tell her?

nodes.text: Actually, it `is` a big deal.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a big deal.

nodes.text: At least apologize for ruining her entire freshman year experience!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
Emily takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, it's okay.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Emily... I wanted to talk to you about the dance.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Kimi and I are so excited!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I already have, like, the `perfect` ensemble. It's never too early to plan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I already have, like, the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] ensemble. It's never too early to plan.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She's totally not kidding. Kimi's the girl who planned her outfit for the first day of school three months in advance!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First impressions! What am I always telling you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, $ZOE, what do you want to tell us about the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no... What's wrong? It's not on the day of the swim meet, is it?

nodes.text: No, it's on the second Saturday, the day of Ben's big basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! Ben doesn't have a basketball game that day... He would've told me...

nodes.text: Apparently, Owen just turned in the permission slips last period, so he probably doesn't know yet...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, no, no! This can't be happening!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.text: Kimi, it's fine. It's just a dance...

nodes.text: Yeah, one of the `ten` you have left in your high school career! You'll never get these memories back if they don't get made!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, one of the [color=#3b78e2][i]ten[/i][/color] you have left in your high school career! You'll never get these memories back if they don't get made!

nodes.text: Maybe I just won't go.

nodes.text: You have to, Em! If you don't go, I can't go... Who'd go with me after the Spreadsheet Disaster of 2012?!

nodes.text: It's just... It was supposed to be a big date night with Ben, and now it's not as special...

nodes.text: Hey, you can `make` it special... Make it a girls' night with Kimi.

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi[/i][/color] likes this idea.

nodes.text: You can dress up together, make each other over, take lots of pictures...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And since it was partially my fault, I'll...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I'll stop by her office now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be safe and good luck! I need to head to class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, I'll need it...
$ZOE grabs her textbooks for her morning classes and heads back into the treacherous hallway to get to Taylor's office.
She gets about halfway down the hall when she hears some screams from the pack of cheerleaders in front of her!
The cheerleaders part, and $ZOE suddenly sees the rebels launch a water balloon, right towards her! She jumps out of the way with a loud squeal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeeeeek!
The rebels advance, each carrying a balloon launcher!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And that's just wave one!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You guys are completely psycho!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yep!
More water balloons are launched at them! $ZOE and some of the other cheerleaders duck into an unused classroom for cover.
After a few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think it's safe now? Surely they're gone by now...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you insane? That's what they want you to think. You're about to walk straight into a trap. These hallways aren't safe anymore!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it's not as bad as all that...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yes, it is!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Well, if we're ever going to get to class, we need to see what's out there... And I volunteer Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What? No!
Jill opens the door and shoves Keith out. He flinches as he staggers outside, but nothing happens. The girls watch with the door cracked open partially.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, I think we're...
A water balloon hits the side of Keith's head, exploding in an impressive burst of water!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Cold! That's cold! Who throws water balloons in winter?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know! But I'm running! Get out while you still can!
Keith takes off down the hall. The other cheerleaders peer around the corner, then sprint into the hallway.
$ZOE sprints out, trying to get her bearings. And that's when she sees another balloon coming straight for her face! She freezes in place, the balloon moving as if in slow motion...
She thinks about the care she put into her wardrobe that morning, and she hopes the balloon won't hit too hard...
And that's when Owen steps in and casually bats it away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet! There's another round coming!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Take this!
Owen takes $ZOE's hand, and together they run away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! And don't let go!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was in the right place at the right time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I'm surprised it's such a zoo in there. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid that's my fault.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your fault? No way you could stir up something like this... You're so sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, but... Really, it is my fault.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember that planning meeting yesterday? I couldn't pick a date for the dance, and that made everyone upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really let people down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, you didn't. It's not like people are mad at `you,` are they?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you didn't. It's not like people are mad at [color=#e23b3b][i]you,[/i][/color] are they?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess not. But people are fighting because of something I did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's my job to make it right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Need some help? I'm not really good at organizing, but I can nod my head a lot and pretend like I'm listening. I'll even say, 'Ooh, good idea!' every once in a while.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... That's okay. I have a date in mind. I'll be announcing it soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's enough about my stupid stuff. How are you doing, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Last time I saw you, you were trying out for...

Meanwhile in the gym, the basketball team meets for practice.
Owen, Spencer, and Ben are playing a three-on-three scrimmage against Andy, Erik, and Jacob.
Ben dribbles down the court as Spencer and Owen keep ahead of him, trying to stay open.
Grr!
Huff... Huff...
Ben passes the ball to Spencer who goes in for a shot. It rebounds off the backboard, and Owen leaps up to get it...
...And his hands close around air!
No!
What?!
Jacob swipes the ball. Owen tries to go after him, but trips over himself! He brings Spencer down with him, and Ben has to leap over them to avoid being tripped.
Stop right there!
The basketball coach blows his whistle, stopping the game. The team gets into a line, and Coach walks up and down it, giving each guy a hard look.
All right, mama's boys! What's going on here?!
I've seen `girls` play better than you!
Well, Coach... The girls' basketball team `is` better than--
Erikson... Shut up.
You all make me sick! Especially you, Harris! You single-handedly took down your entire team! Are you a maggot or a man?!
He looks down imposingly on Owen. Owen gulps.
A man, uh, sir!
Then act like it! We need to win one more game in order to get to Sectionals, and there are only `two` games left to play!
If you play out there the way you're playing now, we're going to get slaughtered!
Now get out of my face. You get five minutes, and then you're running suicides!
The boys head to the water fountain, groaning. In line to grab a drink, Ben turns to Owen.
Hey man... What's going on? You kind of fell all over yourself back there.
Yeah, you suck more than usual!
I'm just off today.
Ben takes his turn at the water fountain, then Owen. They stand, resting against the wall.
So what's bugging you?
It's kind of about the dance...
Yeah, Emily's bummed about that. It sucks that I can't be there.
But hey, at least, I don't have to wear the monkey suit.
I say, who cares? So we're not invited. Whatever. It's just one dumb dance.
It's not going to be as great as seeing the tears of defeat in the other team's loser faces!
It's not really the dance. I don't care about going.
I just thought a friend was coming to see me play that Saturday. But she's got other plans.
It's too bad.
Yeah. Yeah, it is. But maybe I was reading too much into it, you know?
Not really. But you gotta put it out of your mind. You need to focus on basketball.
Of course...
`Basketball.`
